'''2017 US Nationals Chris Gogolen LS Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Gogolen]] at [[2017 U.S. National Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan / A Weakness Can Be Found|V3-L-diplomaticmissiontoalderaan.gif|label=Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125443/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/tournament-decklists.html Internet Archive]
